finding: An accountable coordinator with direct execution, bounded workers, dependency-aware fan-out and external verification fits native capabilities.
change: Kept an instruction-only design; no runtime, scheduler, API client or framework dependency.
evidence: Primary-source research and architecture-v1 design record.

finding: Unconditional fan-out, vague ownership, inflated context, and treating messages as cancellation would create unnecessary or unsafe work.
change: Made usefulness and actual host authority explicit; required a checkable contract and one owner per mutable resource.
evidence: Independent architecture review; issue dispositions incorporated before implementation.

finding: Twelve conceptual scenarios exposed dirty-workspace integration, unresolved writer state, ambiguity and hard-budget edge cases.
change: Added provisional interfaces, selective evidence invalidation, blocked-path handling and honest partial completion.
evidence: Scenario decision table; conceptual review only.

finding: Role ceremony, mandatory ledgers, recursive teams and universal complexity scores did not justify their overhead.
change: Reduced core loop; made ledgers optional, roles situational, and retry/dispatch accounting cumulative.

finding: Ambiguous quantity validation, overstrong writer guarantees and unclear grader integrity semantics could mislead evaluation or users.
change: Clarified the dependency fixture before its run; restricted completion to known task writers; separated active/open-thread limits and syntax/runtime validation.
evidence: Independent implementation review, official skill validator, TOML parsing, evaluator tests.

finding: No concrete release blocker in the frozen skill; real pilot results support only narrow behavior. The grader needed completion evidence beyond exit 0.
change: Added and tested a post-check completion receipt; independently graded all six final runs; reported unmeasured dimensions without a synthetic score.
evidence: 12 evaluator unit tests; four baseline/reference pairs; six parent-graded native runs; final read-only review.
